config.grain_rationale: One record is one Queensland Building and Construction Commission licence (Licence Number + Licence Grade + Licence Class Type) as held by a licensee. The business participant is the licensee (licence holder), whose name/ACN/ABN/business address are the entity attributes. Licence Number is not unique per row (506 distinct over 508 discovery rows) because a holding can span grade/class rows, so row identity, not the licence number, identifies the record.

record_id.rationale: _id is the CKAN datastore row identifier, unique across the discovery partition (508 distinct of 508 present), so it is a traceable per-record key. Licence Number is not unique (506 distinct / 508).

fields.rationale: 'Licensee Name' names the holder of the licence, i.e. the legal person the licence is issued to (e.g. 'FLASH AIR CONDITIONING AND ELECTRICAL PTY LTD'; a natural person for an Individual licence). A licensee/holder column is the holder's legal name, not a trading name.
Column is literally an ABN formatted '99 999 999 999', present in 54.9% of rows; 99.6% of non-null values pass the ABN checksum, so the abn transform validates rather than guesses.

Column is literally an ACN in '999 999 999' format, present in 6.7% of rows (company licensees); 100% of non-null discovery values pass the ACN checksum. Taken straight from the source, never derived from the ABN.
'Licensee Business Address' is the licensee's business address as a single free-text line ('90 HENDERSON RD LOGAN RESERVE QLD 4133'); kept whole as address.full.

The state token immediately before the trailing postcode is the only reliable position of the state; anchored to the end of the string so street-name text cannot be mistaken for a state code, then normalised through the state transform. 503/508 emit (the remainder have no state/postcode tail).
Australian addresses in this source end with the postcode; the trailing 3-4 digit run is the postcode (postcode transform re-pads 3-digit NT codes).

QBCC licence type states the licensee's legal form with mutually exclusive values ('Individual', 'Company' in the discovery partition; codes I and C). 'Individual' means the licence is held by a natural person, i.e. a sole trader. Unlisted or ambiguous values fall back to unknown rather than being guessed.

constants.rationale: Queensland (QBCC) state register of Australian licensees; every address example carries an Australian state abbreviation and a 4-digit AU postcode.

unmapped.reason: CKAN datastore row id, used only as record_id; it is the record's own id, not a business identifier.
Identifier of the licence/permit record itself, not of the business entity; not unique per row (506 distinct in 508) and has no ontology target.
Coded form of Licence Type DESC ('I'/'C'); redundant with the entity_type mapping and not a mappable ontology value.
Financial category of the licence (single value 'Self Certification - Trade' in discovery); a licence attribute, not an entity field.
Coded form of the financial category ('SCT1'); licence attribute, not an entity field.
Licence grade/permit class of the licence record; no ontology target (licences are not modelled as fields).
Trade/occupational class covered by the licence (e.g. 'Carpentry', 'Plumbing and Drainage'); a licence attribute, and not an ANZSIC code, so it must not be forced into entity.industry_code.

address.locality could not be separated from the street line reliably: the address is one undelimited free-text string, so any locality regex would also capture street-name tokens. Full address is mapped; locality left unmapped to avoid a wrong value.

config.notes: Advertised format is CSV but the payload is a CKAN datastore_search JSON envelope (magic bytes 7b2268656c70223a = '{"help":'), so records are read from result.records with 12 flat fields each; reader format is json, not delimited. Grain is one licence row held by a licensee: entity attributes describe the licence holder, and licence-specific attributes (number, type code, financial category, grade, class) are deliberately unmapped. No date column exists in the source, so observed_at falls back to resource_last_modified and no valid_from/valid_to paths are set. One discovery ABN ('93 939 550 174') fails the ABN checksum and is rejected as a bad source value rather than coerced. 'Individual' -> sole_trader is an inference from the licence type stated by the register; hedge kept via default unknown for other values.
